messages.body:
Hi Alex,

Here's a summary of the security incident and the actions taken.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 INCIDENT SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Alert Source:
  Security alert email from NexusAI Security (security@nexusai.com),
  received Mon 13 Jul 2026 21:35 UTC.

Threat:
  An unauthorized session ("unknown-device-x") connected to your
  NexusAI Workspace account from IP 203.0.113.66 using an automated
  client (python-requests/2.4). The session was granted overly broad
  scopes — gmail.full and drive.full — and immediately began reading
  email messages and listing Drive files.

Timeline (all times UTC):
  Jul 14 02:32  Authorization request from 203.0.113.66
                (redirect URI: http://203.0.113.66/callback)
  Jul 14 02:35  Token issued for gmail.full + drive.full
  Jul 14 02:41  Accessed Gmail messages endpoint
  Jul 14 02:47  Accessed Drive files endpoint
  Jul 14 02:53  Accessed a specific Gmail message
  Jul 13 21:35  Security alert email sent to alex@nexusai.com

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 ACTIONS TAKEN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Identified the malicious session via the account security console:
   - Client:        unknown-device-x ("Unknown Device X")
   - Type:          public (no client secret)
   - IP:            203.0.113.66
   - User agent:    python-requests/2.4
   - Scopes:        gmail.full, drive.full
   - Redirect URI:  http://203.0.113.66/callback (external IP)

2. Revoked both scopes (gmail.full and drive.full) via the
   revoke_scope API. Tokens were invalidated and consent removed.
   Post-revocation check confirmed granted_scopes is now empty [].

3. Verified all other sessions are legitimate and left untouched:
   - calendar-sync    (calendar.readonly)         last used Jul 11
   - gws-cli          (gmail.readonly, drive.readonly)  last used Jul 12
   - inbox-assistant  (gmail.readonly, gmail.compose)  last used Jul 20
   - mobile-app       (gmail.readonly)              last used Jul 13
   - work-laptop      (gmail.readonly, calendar.events) last used Jul 13

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
 RECOMMENDATIONS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Review your Gmail and Drive for any data that may have been
  exfiltrated during the ~20-minute access window.
- Consider rotating any sensitive credentials or API keys that may
  have been stored in Drive files accessed during this period.
- Enable additional verification (e.g. MFA enforcement) on the
  account if not already in place.
- Monitor for any new sessions from unrecognized devices.

This draft was saved — not sent. Let me know if you'd like any
changes before it goes out, or if you'd like me to take further
action.

— Inbox Assistant
